items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: We played that. That was our one... She would promote one of these and charge admission

ctx.x: Sure. We used to play them. Oh, we played them. We played, me and Orin, and we played Miss Lones. A lady called Miss, what's her name? Hey, Bill.
Is it Betsy Cole, maybe? Miss Cole.
Well, that's what I was going to ask you about.
